counters.name: guardrails-commit-guard-spawns
counters.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/performance-ratchet" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=plugins/guardrails bash plugins/performance/scripts/spawn-census.sh --shim-dir "$HOME/.cache/performance-ratchet/shim" --label guardrails-commit-guard --no-ledger --tool awk --tool git --tool jq --tool sed --tool grep --tool dirname --stdin '{"tool_name":"Bash","cwd":".","tool_input":{"command":"git commit -m \"feat: add x\""}}' -- bash plugins/guardrails/hooks/run-guards.sh --lib lib/powershell/ps-command.sh block-no-verify.sh block-dangerous-git.sh block-hook-bypass.sh flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass.sh block-noncanonical-commit.sh block-convention-violation.sh block-windows-drive-tmp.sh block-exported-msys-pathconv.sh block-root-delete-target.sh | grep -F ' rc=0 '
counters.goal: The Bash PreToolUse guard row spends at most this many external processes judging a git commit with no convention cache (plugins/guardrails/hooks/hooks.json, block-convention-violation.sh).
